stronger_abstraction: controlled separation between therapeutic introduction and the dominant CSF-clearance path
claim_direction: The patent should cover CONTROLLED SEPARATION (any mechanism that separates drug delivery from drainage), not a specific geometry. The minimum feature is the separation itself, not the spatial position.
note: V6 showed randomized spatial also works. V7 confirms: the minimum structural feature is the SEPARATION itself (reducing drainage-mediated drug loss), not a specific delivery location.
